LOCAL DEMO RESET clears the local panic flag only. There is no claim that orders or exposure are resolved.

Not connected. This page has no webhook field and ignores ?panicWebhook=. A query string cannot choose where STOP goes, because STOP does not go anywhere.

A future real STOP, which this demonstration does not implement, would need a fixed, authenticated destination and a command tied to an approved session (a session id and a request id). A bare action and portfolio name would not be that command.

Paper evolution stays paper. SETS LIVE is a demonstration of an operator screen, not an emergency exit. It cannot place Coinbase orders. Liquidation is not wired. Browser tests do not establish Coinbase isolation. No API keys. Not financial advice.
